# Trademarx
> Trademark registration, trademark search, and ISO certification services in India.
> Authorised trademark agents registered with IP India, based in Ludhiana, Punjab.
> Founded by Anil Bassi (30+ years experience, 5,000+ marks filed) and Ishan Bassi (400+ marks filed).
> 4.9-star rating, 77 Google reviews. Professional fee from ₹1,499.
